# exactl eval

Evaluation scenarios run an agent against a fixed task and score the result. The history keeps every run, and the report compares cells by score, cost and failure class.

## exactl eval run

Run evaluation scenarios

Runs the selected scenarios in the scenario framework and records each run in the history. With `-o jsonl` it prints one event when the run starts and one when it ends, and the scenario output goes to stderr.

The command ends with the exit code of the scenario runner: 0 when every scenario passes, 1 when a scenario fails and 2 on an infrastructure error.

**Usage:** `exactl eval run [options]`

**Options**

- `-P, --pack <pack>`: Run scenarios in a named pack (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--tag <tag>`: Filter by tag (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--scenario <id>`: Run a single named scenario (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--cell <tool>`: Run only the matrix cell whose tool matches (e.g. claude-code, opencode) — every other cell is skipped, not run (type: string)
- `--max-cost-usd <usd>`: Stop scheduling after accumulated tracked cost reaches this cap (skips remaining scenarios; never truncates a running task) (type: number)
- `-v, --verbose`: Show detailed output
- `--score-threshold <threshold>`: Minimum suite score to pass (type: number, default: `0.5`)
- `--trials <n>`: Number of trials per scenario (type: number, default: `1`)
- `--history-store <store>`: History storage: sqlite+jsonl or jsonl (type: string, default: `sqlite+jsonl`)

**Examples**

Run one pack:

```bash
exactl eval run --pack eval-smoke
```

Run one scenario:

```bash
exactl eval run --scenario read-file-roundtrip --trials 3
```

**Output:** stream.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)
- USAGE (2)

**See also:** [exactl eval history](eval.md#exactl-eval-history), [exactl eval report](eval.md#exactl-eval-report)

## exactl eval history

Query the evaluation history

Lists the recorded runs, oldest first, filtered by scenario, pack or date. Use `-n` to keep the last rows.

**Usage:** `exactl eval history [options]`

**Options**

- `-n, --limit <n>`: Show last N entries (type: number)
- `--scenario <id>`: Filter by scenario ID (type: string)
- `--pack <name>`: Filter by pack name (type: string)
- `--since <date>`: Filter to runs since date (ISO 8601) (type: string)

**Examples**

Show the last runs:

```bash
exactl eval history --limit 10
```

Filter by pack:

```bash
exactl eval history --pack eval-smoke -o json
```

**Output:** collection.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)

**See also:** [exactl eval compare](eval.md#exactl-eval-compare), [exactl eval report](eval.md#exactl-eval-report)

## exactl eval compare

Compare two evaluation runs

Prints the score and step differences between two recorded runs.

**Usage:** `exactl eval compare [options]`

**Options**

- `--run-a <id>`: First run ID to compare (type: string, required)
- `--run-b <id>`: Second run ID to compare (type: string, required)

**Examples**

Compare two runs:

```bash
exactl eval compare --run-a run-1 --run-b run-2
```

**Output:** item.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)

**See also:** [exactl eval history](eval.md#exactl-eval-history)

## exactl eval report

Print an evaluation report view

Prints one report view as text: cost, families, lift, ablation, frontier, failures, external, robustness, interactive or memory. The frontier, failures and external views also print JSON with `-o json`.

**Usage:** `exactl eval report [options]`

**Options**

- `--view <view>`: Report view: cost, families, lift, ablation, frontier, failures, external, robustness, interactive, or memory (type: string, default: `cost`)
- `--scenario <id>`: Filter to a single scenario ID (type: string)
- `--pack <pack>`: Filter to a single pack (e.g. swe-tasks) (type: string)
- `-n, --limit <n>`: Limit to the last N runs (type: number)
- `--group-by <prefix>`: Group by tag prefix: subsystem or entity (type: string)
- `--run-ids <ids>`: robustness/interactive views only: comma-separated run IDs to scope the table to (regenerates a founding table exactly, regardless of later local runs) (type: string)

**Examples**

Show the cost view:

```bash
exactl eval report --view cost
```

Show the frontier as JSON:

```bash
exactl eval report --view frontier -o json
```

**Output:** protocol.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)

**See also:** [exactl eval history](eval.md#exactl-eval-history)

## exactl eval calibration generate

Capture judge calls for calibration

Runs real scenarios and writes the judge calls to a directory, so that `eval calibration score` can compare a judge with a reference.

**Usage:** `exactl eval calibration generate [options]`

**Options**

- `-P, --pack <pack>`: Run scenarios in a named pack (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--tag <tag>`: Filter by tag (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--scenario <id>`: Run a single named scenario (repeatable) (type: string)
- `--cell <tool>`: Run only the matrix cell whose tool matches (e.g. claude-code, opencode) (type: string)
- `--max-cost-usd <usd>`: Stop scheduling after accumulated tracked cost reaches this cap (type: number)
- `-v, --verbose`: Show detailed output
- `--capture-calibration-evidence <dir>`: Directory to capture real judge-call evidence into (type: string, required)

**Examples**

Capture the evidence:

```bash
exactl eval calibration generate --pack eval-smoke --capture-calibration-evidence evidence
```

**Output:** stream.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)
- USAGE (2)

**See also:** [exactl eval calibration score](eval.md#exactl-eval-calibration-score)

## exactl eval calibration score

Score judge agreement over captured evidence

Scores how well a judge agrees with a reference evaluator over the captured calibration evidence.

**Usage:** `exactl eval calibration score [options]`

**Options**

- `--capture-dir <dir>`: Directory captured by 'eval calibration generate' (type: string, required)
- `--target <target>`: Target judge, as provider:model (e.g. claude-cli:claude-sonnet-5) (type: string, required)
- `--reference <reference>`: Reference evaluator, as provider:model (e.g. codex-cli:gpt-5.6-sol) (type: string, required)
- `--seed <seed>`: Deterministic selection seed (type: string, required)
- `--sample-count <n>`: Number of eligible artifacts to score (type: number)
- `--label-threshold <n>`: Pass/fail label threshold (0-1) (type: number)
- `--isolated`: Run the reference evaluator in the bwrap-sandboxed isolation profile
- `--report-file <dir>`: Directory to write the calibration report into (type: string)

**Examples**

Score a judge:

```bash
exactl eval calibration score --capture-dir evidence --target claude-cli:claude-sonnet-5 --reference codex-cli:gpt-5.6-sol --seed 1
```

**Output:** protocol.

**Exit codes**

- FAILURE (1)
- USAGE (2)

**See also:** [exactl eval calibration generate](eval.md#exactl-eval-calibration-generate)
